title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Solo #01 (부채꼴·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, demure and soft, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 58% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 2 o'clock, 6 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following the contours of the body, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
